reader.requirement: At --std 85 RANDOM's optional argument-1, when written, must be an integer argument (§1989:A.2.2 AR4) whose value zero or positive is the seed that starts a new repeatable sequence; non-integer arguments are refused and a negative value is outside the permissible range with an undefined result.

reader.notes: The compile-time integer screen is the same edition-blind arm 2023 takes; the seed reaches CobolIntrinsics.Random(Int128), which restarts the run-unit sequence, so equal seeds from literal, P-scaled item, ODO element, expression and integer function give equal values. The negative seed is screened at run time only, which the undefined-result rule permits.
